descriptions.description: The special job of a priest to lead worship and help people connect with God.

Tugas khusus seorang imam untuk memimpin ibadah dan menolong umat terhubung dengan Allah.
A função especial de um sacerdote para liderar a adoração e ajudar as pessoas a se conectarem com Deus.
